headline: DOE insists on Semirara asset disclosure for ‘fair’ auction
summary: Energy Secretary Sharon Garin said the DOE will require Semirara Mining and Power to disclose detailed asset information before competitive bidding for the Semirara coal mine development contract. The current operating contract for the country's largest coal site is held by SMPC.
why: Semirara is the Philippines' largest coal site and supplies power generation, so the contract's terms affect domestic coal supply and power costs.
